messages:
maria: heads up — planning a midnight soak tonight 00:30 UTC. goal: 2h k6/locust mixed traffic replay + circuit-breaker toggles. run id: soak-2024-03-26-01

tony: copying. what's the canary split?

maria: canary groups: 2% / 10% / 88%. start with 2% for 15m then bump if stable.

alyssa: i can take 2% canary and wire up flamegraph upload. send me the pprof url.

maria: pprof at http://10.120.5.12:6060/debug/pprof/heap (ssh jumphost). I'll post a short preflight checklist in a sec.

sam: +1. i'll watch kv-cache hit rate and prefix cache evictions. set alert if missrate > 8% for 5m.

jordan: are we exercising the circuit-breaker fallback path? last soak missed the drop.

maria: yes — we'll flip feature flag `runtime.circuit_breaker` via console during the run. plan: enable at 30m, simulate node failure, then disable.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-flag-toggle job queued by @maria for 1729903000

maria: preflight quick checks:
- verify autoscaler stable
- ensure flamegraph uploader pod has 2x replicas
- check disk iops on /var/log
- confirm locust/k6 scripts loaded into redis

tony: autoscaler: ok (no recent churn). flamegraph-uploader: 1/2 crashlooping, i'll restart.

alyssa: restarted uploader, it's healthy now. uploading test artifact: s3://redwood-internal/temp/flames/soak-dryrun-20240326.svg

sam: k6 command i'll run from runner box:
```
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 2h --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086/run soak-mix.js
```

maria: exact locust mix attached in the repo. small tweak: add a 5% heavier-user path to exercise long prompts.

jordan: add this log command for quick tailing during node failure:
```
ssh jump 'kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=10m | grep "evict" -A3'
```

sam: note — collector CPU alert: cpu.p95 > 75% triggers paging. can we raise to 85% for soak window?

maria: agreed, bump alert to 85% for tonight only. i'll annotate on the alert policy.

tony: PR #4321 adds the regression test that failed last time. Can someone review? small change in batching logic.

alyssa: i'll review in 30m.

maria: any blockers for payload size test? we want sequences ~4k tokens, with quantized model path exercised.

jordan: need to ensure model-quantized variant is in route table — i'll push a routing config at 1729902700.

infra-bot: routing config push complete by @jordan at 1729902725

sam: reminder — enable full debug logs for 10m during the simulated node kill. dump will be uploaded to s3.

maria: plan for simulated node failure:
- cordon one runtime node
- kill process runtime-server on that node
- wait 2m
- uncordon

tony: i can run the cordon/kill. assign to me.

maria: assigned to @tony. call out in thread when you start.

deploy-bot: canary toggle executed: runtime.circuit_breaker=on by @maria at 1729903005

tony: starting cordon+kill in ~5m. :eyes:

alyssa: flamegraph uploader watching — will post link after kill.

sam: monitoring dashboards: kv missrate spike at +12% now, increased latency on workqueue. keeping an eye.

jordan: routing held as expected; fallback model variant served ~3% of requests during the window.

maria: after the run please paste the key numbers: p95 latency, token cost delta, kv missrate, error budget impact.

alyssa: uploaded flamegraphs: s3://redwood-internal/soak/2024-03-26/flame-1.svg (canary 2%) and flame-2.svg (10%)

tony: cordon+kill done. called start at 1729903120. saw conn drops then steady failover.

sam: collected jemalloc stats and heap dumps — uploading: s3://redwood-internal/soak/2024-03-26/heap-dumps/

maria: nice. let's keep the 2% canary for another 15m then promote to 10% if metrics stable.

infra-bot: canary promotion job queued by @maria -> 10% at 1729904020

jordan: quick note — one ingress node saw 503 spike; root cause looks like ingress queue overflow. filing follow-up.

maria: thanks team. assign postmortem owner? @alyssa can you lead? :thumbsup:

alyssa: happy to own the postmortem. will draft and include perf diffs and the flamegraphs.

tony: PR #4321 reviewed and LGTM'd. merging now.

maria: excellent. anyone still watching? if not we'll call this wrapped and archive logs.

sam: i'm still watching for another 10m.

maria: ok wrap in 10m, then i'll post the summary and archive links.

deploy-bot: canary promotion executed by @maria -> 10% at 1729904025

maria: done for now — thanks all, summary will be up in #eng-runtime later today. :rocket:
